units.text: S1/D4 degree in one of: Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Statistika, Matematika, Sistem Informasi, Data Science, or a related relevant field

branches.text: S1/D4 degree in a related relevant field

source_quotes: Lulusan S1/D4 dari jurusan Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Statistika, Matematika, Sistem Informasi, Data Science, atau bidang terkait yang relevan.

units.text: Must have one or more of: experience in data analysis & processing and basic understanding of statistics; ability to design machine learning and predictive modeling; data visualization skills (such as Tableau, Power BI, or related libraries); critical thinking in formulating data-driven insights and recommendations

branches.text: Experience in data analysis & processing and basic understanding of statistics
Ability to design machine learning and predictive modeling
Data visualization skills (such as Tableau, Power BI, or related libraries)
Critical thinking in formulating data-driven insights and recommendations

source_quotes: Keahlian Khusus (Wajib memiliki salah satu atau lebih dari poin berikut):
Pengalaman dalam analisis & pengolahan data serta pemahaman dasar statistika.
Kemampuan merancang machine learning dan predictive modeling.
Keterampilan data visualization (seperti Tableau, Power BI, atau library terkait).
Kemampuan berpikir kritis dalam penyusunan insight dan rekomendasi berbasis data.
